articles.abstract_en: Financial crises typically occur because firms and financial institutions are highly exposed to aggregate shocks. We propose a theory to explain these exposures. We study a model where entrepreneurs can issue state-contingent claims to consumers. Even though entrepreneurs can use these instruments to hedge negative shocks, they do not necessarily do so because insuring against these shocks is expensive, as consumers are also harmed by them. This effect is self-reinforcing because riskier balance sheets for entrepreneurs imply higher income volatility for the consumers, making insurance more costly in equilibrium. We show that this feedback is quantitatively important and leads to inefficiently high risk exposure for entrepreneurs.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融危机通常发生是因为企业和金融机构高度暴露于总体冲击。我们提出了一个理论来解释这些暴露。我们研究了一个模型，其中企业家可以向消费者发行状态依赖的索取权。尽管企业家可以使用这些工具来对冲负面冲击，但他们不一定这样做，因为为这些冲击投保是昂贵的，因为消费者也受到这些冲击的伤害。这种效应是自我强化的，因为企业家风险更高的资产负债表意味着消费者收入波动性更高，从而使保险在均衡中更加昂贵。我们表明，这种反馈在数量上是重要的，并导致企业家面临低效的高风险暴露。

articles.title_en: What Do Employee Referral Programs Do? Measuring the Direct and Overall Effects of a Management Practice
articles.title_cn: 员工推荐计划有何作用？衡量一项管理实践的直接效应与总体效应
articles.abstract_en: Employee referral programs (ERPs) are randomly introduced in a grocery chain. On direct effects, larger referral bonuses increase referral quantity but decrease quality, though the increase in referrals from ERPs is modest. However, the overall effect of having an ERP is substantial, reducing attrition by 15% and significantly decreasing labor costs. This occurs, partly, because referrals stay longer than nonreferrals, but, mainly, from indirect effects: nonreferrals stay longer in treated than in control stores. The most supported mechanism for these indirect effects is workers value being involved in hiring. Attrition impacts are larger in higher performing stores and better local labor markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 员工推荐计划（ERPs）在一家连锁杂货店中被随机引入。就直接效应而言，更大的推荐奖金增加了推荐数量但降低了推荐质量，尽管来自ERPs的推荐增加幅度有限。然而，实施ERP的总体效应是显著的，将离职率降低了15%，并显著降低了劳动力成本。这在一定程度上是因为推荐员工比非推荐员工留任时间更长，但主要源于间接效应：在实验组门店中，非推荐员工的留任时间比对照组门店更长。对这些间接效应最有力的机制解释是，员工重视参与招聘过程。离职率的影响在绩效更高的门店和更好的本地劳动力市场中更为显著。

articles.title_en: Mixture Choice Data: Revealing Preferences and Cognition
articles.title_cn: 混合选择数据：揭示偏好与认知
articles.abstract_en: Mixture choice data consist of the joint distribution of choices of a group of agents from a collection of menus, comprising the implied stochastic choice function plus any cross-menu correlations. When agents are heterogeneous with respect to both preferences and other aspects of cognition, we show that these two determinants of behavior are identified simultaneously by suitable mixture choice data. We also demonstrate how this finding can be extended to allow for specialized assumptions about cognition, focusing on models of random satisficing thresholds and “quantal Fechnerian” choice.
articles.abstract_cn: 混合选择数据由一组代理人从一系列菜单中进行选择的联合分布组成，包括隐含的随机选择函数以及任何跨菜单相关性。当代理人在偏好和认知的其他方面均存在异质性时，我们表明行为的这两个决定因素可以通过适当的混合选择数据同时被识别。我们还展示了这一发现如何扩展到允许关于认知的专门假设，重点关注随机满足阈值和“量子费希纳式”选择模型。

articles.title_en: When Parents Decide: Gender Differences in Competitiveness
articles.title_cn: 当父母做决定：竞争力中的性别差异
articles.abstract_en: Parents make important choices for their children in many areas of life, yet the empirical literature on this topic is scarce. We study parents’ competitiveness choices for their children by combining two large-scale artifactual field experiments with high-quality longitudinal administrative data. We document three main sets of findings. First, parents choose more competition for their sons than daughters. Second, this gender difference can largely be explained by parents’ beliefs about their children’s competitiveness preferences. Third, parents’ choices predict children’s later-in-life educational outcomes. Taken together, these findings provide novel evidence on the role of parents in shaping children’s long-term outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 父母在生活的许多领域为子女做出重要选择，然而关于这一主题的实证文献却很少。我们通过结合两项大规模人工实地实验与高质量的纵向行政数据，研究了父母为子女做出的竞争力选择。我们记录了三大类主要发现。首先，父母为儿子选择的竞争多于为女儿选择的竞争。其次，这种性别差异在很大程度上可以由父母对其子女竞争力偏好的信念来解释。第三，父母的选择能够预测子女日后在教育方面的成果。综合来看，这些发现为父母在塑造子女长期成果中的作用提供了新的证据。

articles.abstract_en: We consider a mechanism design setting in which agents can acquire costly information on their preferences as well as others’. A mechanism is informationally simple if agents have no incentive to learn about others’ preferences. This property is of interest for two reasons. First, it is a necessary condition for the existence of dominant-strategy equilibria in the extended game. Second, this endogenizes an “independent-private-value” property of the interim information structure. We show that, generically, a mechanism is informationally simple if and only if it satisfies a separability condition that rules out most economically meaningful mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个机制设计环境，其中代理人可以获取关于自身偏好以及他人偏好的昂贵信息。如果代理人没有动机去了解他人的偏好，则该机制是信息简单的。这一性质之所以引人关注，原因有二。首先，它是扩展博弈中占优策略均衡存在的必要条件。其次，它内生化了中期信息结构的“独立私人价值”性质。我们证明，在一般情况下，一个机制是信息简单的当且仅当它满足一个可分离性条件，该条件排除了大多数具有经济意义的机制。
